scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. Your client writes software for its own group. Can the transfer pricing officer compare it with giants like Infosys and Wipro?
On twenty eighth October, a Karnataka High Court bench of Honourable Chief Justice Vibhu Bakhru and Honourable Justice K S Hemalekha ruled.
scenes.shown: On 28 October, a Karnataka High Court bench of Honourable Chief Justice Vibhu Bakhru and Honourable Justice K.S. Hemalekha ruled.

scenes.dialogue: Logica, a software services company, faced a transfer pricing adjustment of nearly forty crore rupees, for assessment year two thousand seven to eight.
scenes.shown: Logica, a software services company, faced a transfer pricing adjustment of nearly ₹40 crore, for assessment year 2007-08.

scenes.dialogue: The Transfer Pricing Officer picked twenty six comparables, including Infosys and Wipro. Their average markup on cost was about twenty five percent.
scenes.shown: The Transfer Pricing Officer picked 26 comparables, including Infosys and Wipro. Their average markup on cost was about 25%.

scenes.dialogue: The Tribunal struck out eight comparables, Infosys and Wipro among them, and tightened the related party filter from twenty five to fifteen percent.
scenes.shown: The Tribunal struck out eight comparables, Infosys and Wipro among them, and tightened the related party filter from 25% to 15%.

scenes.dialogue: The Revenue appealed. After a Supreme Court remand, it argued that brand and size don't affect margins, and that the fifteen percent filter had no basis.
scenes.shown: The Revenue appealed. After a Supreme Court remand, it argued that brand and size don't affect margins, and that the 15% filter had no basis.

scenes.dialogue: The High Court disagreed. Size matters: a giant's cost structure may differ. T N M M tolerates variations, but not an extremely large gap in size.
scenes.shown: The High Court disagreed. Size matters: a giant's cost structure may differ. TNMM tolerates variations, but not an extremely large gap in size.

scenes.dialogue: An established brand bears on margins, so Infosys and Wipro were rightly excluded. Product, training and drug discovery firms were found functionally different.
The fifteen percent related party filter was upheld, as enough comparables remained. No substantial question of law arose. The appeal was dismissed.
scenes.shown: The 15% related party filter was upheld, as enough comparables remained. No substantial question of law arose. The appeal was dismissed.
